routes.name: passport
routes.title: URAI Passport
routes.textSample:
URAI PASSPORT · ACCESS LAYER
Own your life. Live your world.

Passport is the trust layer underneath URAI Spatial: identity, consent, provenance, and access all stay visible. It is built so the Life Map can feel alive without turning a person's private life into someone else's asset.

Return Home
Open Life Map
Open Focus
View Status
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Identity

Your world has an owner: you. URAI treats identity as permission, not extraction.

Provenance

Every memory surface keeps a clear trail back to where it came from and why it appears.

Control

Life Map, Focus, Replay, and Mirror stay connected through user-controlled access gates.
